# A pine: a trunk and three stacked six-sided cones (generated by make_env.py), origin at its foot.
new
material new Needles --base-color 0.227 0.373 0.231 --no-slot
material new Trunk --base-color 0.404 0.322 0.224 --no-slot
add mesh cylinder --name Trunk --vertices 6 --radius 0.13 --depth 0.5 --location 0 0 0.25
material assign Trunk
add mesh cone --name Tier0 --vertices 6 --radius1 0.75 --radius2 0.02 --depth 1.0 --location 0 0 0.75
material assign Needles
add mesh cone --name Tier1 --vertices 6 --radius1 0.58 --radius2 0.02 --depth 0.9 --location 0 0 1.35
material assign Needles
add mesh cone --name Tier2 --vertices 6 --radius1 0.38 --radius2 0.02 --depth 0.8 --location 0 0 1.9
material assign Needles
select all
shade flat
export pine.glb
